srList.sentence: After receiving approval from the institutional review board for our health system, patient data were retrospectively collected by searching the following Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) codes: 29891 (arthroscopy, ankle, surgical excision of osteochondral defect of talus and/or tibia), 29892 (arthroscopically aided repair of large osteochondritis dissecans lesion), 29894 (arthroscopy, ankle, with removal of loose or foreign body), 29895 (arthroscopy, ankle, with partial synovectomy), 29897 (arthroscopy, ankle, limited surgical debridement), 29898 (arthroscopy, ankle, extensive surgical debridement), and 29899 (arthroscopy, ankle, with ankle arthrodesis).
